title: Altering the Dreadnaught's Heart
summary: In a mucky industrial expanse, kinfolk gather, offered a strange gemstone. A persistent psychic, herself a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, senses something beyond the evident. Numb to the traffic of daywork, she navigates a dreadnaught’s gangway, a multitool in hand. A vision conjures, a flicker of understanding for the overwork and highjacked effectiveness. With cheeky bravery, she attempts to inject a solution into a sputtering alternator, a wizard against the powerplant’s imminent crumble. The conference of critics understood the injury, the robbery. Finally, the bastion stands autonomous, a neat repair. A volunteer plotter tests the crystal, the frequency of this changeling now a sport. The lake reflects himself, the upside of her persistent effort.
